fields.name: grasp_point
fields.description: The [y, x] of the peg end the demonstration gripper closed on. Set at the first decision step from the demonstration frame where the gripper is at its lowest (height about 0.01-0.03) and the fingers go from 100% open to about 22% open: take the peg head or peg tail entry nearest the gripper position in that frame, and record that end's coordinates as they appear in the start-of-execution scene (the pegs lie at the same positions as at demonstration t=0). Never changes afterwards. e.g. [114, 212]

fields.name: grasp_end
fields.description: Which end of the peg the demonstration gripper closed on, head or tail. Set at the first decision step from the same grasp frame as grasp_point: whichever of peg head / peg tail is nearest the gripper at the moment the fingers close. Never changes afterwards. e.g. tail

fields.name: insert_side
fields.description: The side of the box the demonstration inserted the peg from, right or left. Set at the first decision step from the final demonstration frames (gripper low, height about 0.04, fingers still closed, gripper y near the aperture box y): if the gripper x there is SMALLER than the aperture box x the value is right; if LARGER it is left. Never changes afterwards. e.g. right
